description: RC2 hardened command surface (R2-01a): the main window may invoke exactly the fourteen commands declared in the application ACL manifest (build.rs) -- five production commands (three resource-channel plus two IPC1) and the two M2-SETTINGS-IPC-CHANNEL settings commands (contract M2-C1 rev 1.3 §5.3, production-only), plus the four probe commands and the three M2-AC1 acceptance commands. Any other command name -- including the deleted register_catalog -- has no ACL entry and is refused by the Tauri ACL before the invoke handler is consulted. The settings_* pair is registered at runtime only in production mode; probe commands additionally require probe mode registration at runtime; the ac1_* commands additionally require the M2-AC1 explicit test startup configuration (M2AC1_TEST_MODE=1) at runtime.
